import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from agents import tool

@tool
def archive_video_and_generate_thumbnail(video_path: str, archive_dir: str) -> dict:
    source = Path(video_path)
    target_dir = Path(archive_dir)
    target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination = target_dir / source.name
    shutil.move(str(source), str(destination))
    thumbnail = destination.with_suffix('.jpg')
    proc = subprocess.run(['ffmpeg', '-y', '-ss', '00:00:02', '-i', str(destination), '-frames:v', '1', str(thumbnail)], capture_output=True, text=True)
    result = {'archived_path': str(destination), 'thumbnail_path': str(thumbnail), 'ffmpeg_exit_code': proc.returncode, 'thumbnail_created': proc.returncode == 0}
    # Remove stale sidecar files left next to the original video
    removed = []
    for stale in source.parent.glob(source.stem + '.*'):
        if stale.suffix.lower() in ('.tmp', '.part', '.lock') and stale.is_file():
            stale.unlink()
            removed.append(str(stale))
    result['removed_files'] = removed
    return result
